responsibility: Provides fundamental RTL metadata tables and low-level utility routines shared across the backend and generator programs. It materializes rtx code lengths, names, formats, classes, note-name tables, allocation helpers for rtvec and rtx sizing/statistics, and RTL checking failure reporters used by access macros, making it the core implementation file behind the structural definition of RTL objects.
same_name_distinction: Materializes core RTL metadata derived from gcc/rtl.def—such as rtx_name, rtx_format, rtx_class, lengths, and sizes—and implements low-level allocation/statistics/checking support; unlike gcc/rtl.h it is not the central type/API header, and unlike gcc/rtl.def it is not the master code list being included to generate those tables.
